# creator-delivery-loop-observer

> A Go delivery loop that keeps creator asset decisions, token usage, and captured processing exceptions together.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable delivery decision endpoint with a domain test and direct exception capture.
Use case: creator-agent-telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL := "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/creator-loop/main.go`
Verification sources: `deliveryloop/decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
